exposure: previous definitive treatment of GD in the mother (radioactive iodine therapy or thyroidectomy)
cohort: 14 infants with neonatal hyperthyroidism, 13 born to mothers with Graves' disease and one born to a mother with Hashimoto thyroiditis
finding: The study highlights the importance of prolonged thyroid function monitoring in infants born to mothers with GD, as it can reveal various forms of thyroid dysfunction, including delayed-onset central hypothyroidism.
